[*] Fixed "teleport" bug when cancelling the overhang grappling hook at the wrong moment

[/list]

[list]

[*]All achievements and leader boards are no longer tied to STEAM but are now global and cross-platform
[*]Added a new, 7th playable Character: Amira Lubya with a special ability of "Electro Homing missiles" (pretty awesome if you ask me!)
[*]Complete remake of Mission 1
[*]Heavily updated Mission 5
[*]More heavy overhaul of the missions will be on their way soon! stay tuned! Thanks again for the critics and feedback of some of our users!
[/list]

notes.title: Respawn is now live!!
notes.content:
This is it! Huge update! The most awaited respawn feature is now live. You can now respawn from check points that you activate during missions. No more frustration of having the retry from the start. We have also added some visual UI for objectives, making it easier to locate what you have to do. We also redesign slightly Missions #5, 6, 7 and 8.
We're very excited about this update and we do hope that you'll enjoy this massive improvement.

Stay tuned as we'll also release soon 2 new missions and a new arena.

Cheers! :)

notes.content:
This is it! Stellar Ghosts Settlers has finally been released and is offered at a preferred 30% off discount for its first week on the STEAM Store! (Discount ends on December 12th 2023) Get it now and enjoy a 3rd Person Shooter that sticks to the basics and won't disappoint you.
